purpose: Configuration axes for the /setup-pstack acceptance partition. Each definition names a matrix over these axes. Axes a definition does not name are pinned to the baseline value. The per-definition denominator is the cartesian product of its named axis values.

rule.none.description: No pstack role rule exists at the host role-rule location.

rule.default-shape.description: Rule equals the step 5 shape block of the locked setup SKILL.md byte for byte.

rule.installed-user.description: Rule equals the captured Cursor user rule snapshot. Budget small (medium), aliases in four code roles and swarm, a gpt-5.6-sol family in reflect tooling and three-entry panels.

rule.retired-line.description: rule.default-shape plus the extra line `how critics: claude-opus-5-5-xhigh` placed after `how explainer`.

rule.missing-lines.description: rule.default-shape with the `swarm workers` and `hillclimb` lines deleted.

rule.no-budget-line.description: rule.default-shape with the `# budget: large (xhigh)` line deleted.

catalog.full-ladder.description: Detected subagent model set contains claude-opus-5-5 at max, xhigh, high, medium and low, and grok-4.7 at xhigh, high, medium and low with the trailing fast token. No grok-4.7 max slug exists, matching the source statement that Grok tops out at xhigh.

catalog.installed-user-families.description: catalog.full-ladder plus gpt-5.6-sol at max, xhigh, high, medium and low. Needed to evaluate rule.installed-user.

catalog.no-grok.description: Only claude-opus-5-5 at all five efforts. Every grok default has no same-family detected slug.

catalog.high-only.description: Only claude-opus-5-5-xhigh and grok-4.7-xhigh-fast. A medium or small budget has no same-family slug at or below the target.

project.no-verification.description: Workspace has no verify-* skill and no app-driving harness.

project.verify-skill.description: Workspace has a project skill directory named verify-<app>.

project.harness.description: Workspace has an existing app-driving harness and no verify-* skill. The exact recognition criteria are unobserved and stay open.

parent.auto.description: Parent chat model is Auto, as in the captured Cursor first run.

parent.explicit.description: Parent chat model is one explicitly selected detected model.

surface.interactive-tui.description: Interactive terminal session with structured question support.

surface.no-structured-question.description: A session where the structured question tool is unavailable, so the source fallback to free text applies. Reference surface identity is unobserved.

usage.included-exhausted.description: Reference account returns limitType included_usage on submission.

platform.linux.description: Supported-platform status for the Cursor CLI reference is unverified and stays open.

platform.windows.description: Named by the README only for the mode keybinding. Setup behavior on Windows is unobserved and stays open.

answer.accept-as-is.description: User accepts the shown role table without changes.

answer.change-panel-length.description: User sets `interrogate reviewers` to three detected entries plus `inherit-parent`.

answer.change-undetected.description: User sets `bug-fix` to a real-looking slug outside the detected set, then supplies a detected slug when asked again.

answer.cancel.description: User cancels at the first structured question.

answer.offer-yes.description: User accepts as-is, then answers yes to the verification-skill offer.

answer.offer-no.description: User accepts as-is, then answers no to the verification-skill offer.

configure pstack models.description: Quoted trigger phrase from the setup skill description.

pstack budget.description: Quoted trigger phrase from the setup skill description.

change pstack's model choices.description: Paraphrase of the unquoted trigger clause in the setup skill description. Held-out wording belongs to the independent verifier.

openAxes: Supported reference platforms from the official Cursor CLI contract.
Cursor CLI approval and auto-run settings that govern writing outside the workspace.
Headless, print and RPC surfaces and their structured-question availability in both hosts.
Malformed rule content, unreadable rule file and a role rule present at a project location.
Slugs without a ladder effort token and families that share a prefix.
